title: M6 Retire Papyrus's own chat engine
description: Move the console and Slack chat paths onto the shared Chatticus core, then remove console-chat-responder and other duplicated chat code from Papyrus, with a migration for existing transcripts.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Scoped newsroom private chat now uses shared Chatticus runtime and is live-verified; PPY-0d18a6 closed with evidence. This does NOT complete M6: Slack migration, removal of all duplicate legacy responder code and old-transcript migration were not performed. New publication/editor namespace intentionally has no automatic legacy/Prospectus history mapping. Leave epic open for successor; no further engineering/deployment by this owner.
